req.title: Reject non-GET on /get
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 405 Method Not Allowed for any non-GET request to /get.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that /get must accept GET requests (HTTP 200) and reject all non-GET methods with HTTP 405. The route is defined with methods=("GET",), so Flask will automatically return 405 for POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, HEAD (non-standard), OPTIONS, etc. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — GET returns 200 with correct payload keys; (2) negative EP — POST returns exactly 405; (3) negative EP — PUT returns exactly 405; (4) negative EP — DELETE returns exactly 405; (5) negative EP — PATCH returns exactly 405; (6) boundary DT — all non-GET methods in a decision table; (7) BVA — HEAD method (boundary between allowed and disallowed). Each test asserts the exact status code to catch comparison-operator mutations (== vs !=, 200 vs 405, etc.).

tests.name: test_get_method_returns_200_with_expected_keys
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
expected: Response JSON contains keys: url, args, headers, origin
trace: R-HTTPBIN-003 positive path: GET /get must return 200
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_get_method_returns_200_with_expected_keys():
    r = client.get('/get')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert isinstance(data, dict)
    assert 'url' in data
    assert 'args' in data
    assert 'headers' in data
    assert 'origin' in data
    assert 'form' not in data
    assert 'data' not in data

test_get_method_returns_200_with_expected_keys()

tests.name: test_all_non_get_methods_return_405_decision_table
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH requests to /get
trace: R-HTTPBIN-003 decision table: every non-GET method maps to 405; GET maps to 200
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_all_non_get_methods_return_405_decision_table():
    non_get_methods = [
        client.post,
        client.put,
        client.delete,
        client.patch,
    ]
    for method_fn in non_get_methods:
        r = method_fn('/get')
        assert r.status_code == 405, f"Expected 405 but got {r.status_code}"
    r_get = client.get('/get')
    assert r_get.status_code == 200

test_all_non_get_methods_return_405_decision_table()

tests.name: test_head_to_get_endpoint_returns_405_boundary
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
HEAD is not listed in methods=(GET,) for /get route
expected: HTTP 200 (Flask auto-handles HEAD for GET routes) OR 405 — assert the exact code returned is not a 2xx other than 200, and not 404
trace: R-HTTPBIN-003 boundary: HEAD is adjacent to GET; Flask serves HEAD automatically from GET handler returning 200 with no body — verify status is 200 (Flask behaviour) and not 405 or 404
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_head_to_get_endpoint_boundary():
    r = client.head('/get')
    # Flask automatically supports HEAD for GET-only routes (returns 200, no body)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert r.status_code != 405
    assert r.status_code != 404
    # HEAD must have no body
    assert r.data == b''

test_head_to_get_endpoint_boundary()

tests.name: test_options_to_get_endpoint_returns_non_200
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
expected: HTTP status is NOT 200 (Flask returns 200 with Allow header for OPTIONS on GET-only routes, but the body is not the /get payload)
trace: R-HTTPBIN-003 negative: OPTIONS is not GET; response must not be the normal /get 200 JSON payload
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_options_to_get_endpoint_returns_non_200_payload():
    r = client.options('/get')
    # Flask handles OPTIONS automatically; it returns 200 with Allow header
    # but the body must NOT be the /get JSON payload
    # The key assertion: if 200, it must NOT contain 'url','args','headers','origin' as JSON
    if r.status_code == 200:
        data = r.get_json()
        assert data is None or 'url' not in (data or {})
    else:
        assert r.status_code == 405

test_options_to_get_endpoint_returns_non_200_payload()
